title: コードレスドリル
description: 施設保守や内装作業台向けの携帯ドリル。傾斜した握り、着脱式風の固定バッテリー、前後の操作部、通気部、チャックと三つの固定爪、細いねじれ形状のビット、ベルトフックを造形。バッテリー上で立つ姿勢です。据置ボール盤とは異なる手持ち工具で、ビット・バッテリーを含め一式1点です。回転・穴あけ・電池・調整動作や実用品安全性は未検証です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.098 × 0.284 × 0.363 m、8,730三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A portable drill for facility-maintenance and interior-work benches, with slanted grip, fixed slide-in-style battery, controls, vents, chuck with three static jaws, narrow helical bit and belt hook. Presented standing on the battery. Unlike a floor drill press, it is a handheld assembly; bit and battery count within one model. Rotation, drilling, battery operation, adjustment and real tool safety are unvalidated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.098 × 0.284 × 0.363 m; 8,730 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
